aggregate.description:
A registered person on the platform, identified by a system ID and an external ID.

The Customer aggregate groups profile, addresses, account status, and loyalty tier
into a single transactional boundary. The "exactly one default address" invariant
requires these elements to change together consistently.
aggregate.name: Customer

identity.customer.account.ReactivateAcco.description: Restore a suspended customer account to active status.
identity.customer.account.ReactivateAcco.name: ReactivateAccount

identity.customer.account.SuspendAccount.description: Temporarily suspend a customer account, blocking further activity.
identity.customer.account.SuspendAccount.name: SuspendAccount

identity.customer.addresses.AddAddress.description: Add a new address to a customer's address book.
identity.customer.addresses.AddAddress.name: AddAddress

identity.customer.addresses.RemoveAddres.description: Remove an address from a customer's address book.
identity.customer.addresses.RemoveAddres.name: RemoveAddress

identity.customer.addresses.SetDefaultAd.description: Designate an existing address as the customer's default.
identity.customer.addresses.SetDefaultAd.name: SetDefaultAddress

identity.customer.addresses.UpdateAddres.description: Modify fields of an existing address.
identity.customer.addresses.UpdateAddres.name: UpdateAddress

identity.customer.profile.UpdateProfile.description: Change a customer's personal profile information (name, phone, date of birth).
identity.customer.profile.UpdateProfile.name: UpdateProfile

identity.customer.registration.RegisterC.description: Create a new customer account with profile information.
identity.customer.registration.RegisterC.name: RegisterCustomer

identity.customer.tier.UpgradeTier.description: Promote a customer to a higher loyalty tier (upgrades only, no downgrades).
identity.customer.tier.UpgradeTier.name: UpgradeTier

identity.customer.customer.Address.description:
A physical location associated with a Customer, such as a home or work address.

Each address carries a label, geo-coordinates, and a default flag. A customer may
have up to 10 addresses, with exactly one marked as the default at all times.
identity.customer.customer.Address.name: Address

identity.customer.events.AccountClosed.description: A customer account was permanently closed.
identity.customer.events.AccountClosed.name: AccountClosed

identity.customer.events.AccountReactiva.description: A previously suspended customer account was restored to active status.
identity.customer.events.AccountReactiva.name: AccountReactivated

identity.customer.events.AccountSuspende.description: A customer account was suspended, blocking further activity.
identity.customer.events.AccountSuspende.name: AccountSuspended

identity.customer.events.AddressAdded.description: A new address was added to a customer's address book.
identity.customer.events.AddressAdded.name: AddressAdded

identity.customer.events.AddressRemoved.description: An address was removed from a customer's address book.
identity.customer.events.AddressRemoved.name: AddressRemoved

identity.customer.events.AddressUpdated.description: An existing address in a customer's address book was modified.
identity.customer.events.AddressUpdated.name: AddressUpdated

identity.customer.events.CustomerRegiste.description: A new customer account was created on the platform.
identity.customer.events.CustomerRegiste.name: CustomerRegistered

identity.customer.events.DefaultAddressC.description: A different address was designated as the customer's default.
identity.customer.events.DefaultAddressC.name: DefaultAddressChanged

identity.customer.events.ProfileUpdated.description: A customer's personal profile information was changed.
identity.customer.events.ProfileUpdated.name: ProfileUpdated

identity.customer.events.TierUpgraded.description: A customer was promoted to a higher loyalty tier.
identity.customer.events.TierUpgraded.name: TierUpgraded

identity.customer.customer.GeoCoordinate.description:
Latitude/longitude pair for address geolocation.

Both coordinates are required when provided; partial coordinates are rejected.
Latitude ranges from -90 to 90, longitude from -180 to 180.
identity.customer.customer.GeoCoordinate.name: GeoCoordinates

identity.customer.customer.Profile.description:
Personal information associated with a Customer — name, phone, and date of birth.

A Profile has no identity of its own; it exists only as part of a Customer.
It is replaced wholesale on update (value object semantics).
identity.customer.customer.Profile.name: Profile

identity.shared.email.EmailAddress.description:
A validated email address conforming to standard format rules.

Enforces structural validity: exactly one @, valid local and domain parts,
no consecutive dots, no forbidden characters. Used across contexts wherever
an email is required.
identity.shared.email.EmailAddress.name: EmailAddress
